author: DeDust
description: DeDust Jetton Vault V2 is a token vault that receives jettons and routes swaps, liquidity deposits, and payouts through DeDust v2.

declarations.name: DedustVaultJettonV2Storage

fields.name: cachedProof
fields.description: Cached proof data ref containing Factory address, DeDust contract type, and the vaulted asset.

fields.name: blankCode
fields.description: Blank code cell used with `cachedProof` to reconstruct the deterministic StateInit hash.

fields.name: isReady
fields.description: Readiness bit returned by `is_ready`; false before the Jetton wallet address is synced.

fields.name: jettonMinterAddr
fields.description: Jetton minter address for the vaulted asset, also duplicated in `cachedProof.asset`.

fields.name: jettonWalletAddr
fields.description: Vault-owned Jetton wallet address; stored as `addr_none` until readiness sync completes.

fields.name: version
fields.description: Code/interface version returned by `get_version`.

declarations.description: Runtime storage loaded by the verified Jetton Vault code root data cell.

declarations.name: DedustVaultJettonV2ProofData

fields.name: factoryAddr
fields.description: Factory address that deterministically owns this vault family.

fields.name: contractType
fields.description: DeDust contract type tag; live Jetton Vault storage stores `1` for vault.

fields.name: asset
fields.description: Asset parameter for this vault, proven live as the USDT Jetton asset.

declarations.description: DeDust proof data stored by the vault and used in pool/factory authentication.

declarations.name: DedustNativeAsset
declarations.description: Native asset tag used by common DeDust PoolParams, but not by this Jetton Vault storage instance.

declarations.name: DedustJettonAsset

fields.name: workchainId

fields.name: address
fields.description: Jetton minter account hash.

declarations.description: Jetton asset tag supported by DeDust SDK, docs, and the live USDT vault storage.

declarations.name: DedustAsset
declarations.description: Asset variants proven by SDK/local TL-B for DeDust v2 core messages.

declarations.name: DedustVolatilePool
declarations.description: Volatile pool type tag used in PoolParams.

declarations.name: DedustStablePool
declarations.description: Stable pool type tag used in PoolParams.

declarations.name: DedustPoolType
declarations.description: Pool type variants encoded as one bit in DeDust pool parameters.

declarations.name: DedustPoolParams

fields.name: poolType
fields.description: Pool curve type, volatile or stable.

fields.name: asset0
fields.description: First sorted pool asset.

fields.name: asset1
fields.description: Second sorted pool asset.

declarations.description: Pool identity tuple used by Jetton forward payloads and Factory routing.

declarations.name: DedustGivenIn
declarations.description: Swap kind tag for exact-in swaps; SDK currently stores only this value.

declarations.name: DedustGivenOut
declarations.description: Swap kind tag for exact-out swaps; docs say this variant is not implemented.

declarations.name: DedustSwapKind
declarations.description: One-bit swap direction encoded inside a swap step.

declarations.name: DedustSwapStepParams

fields.name: kind
fields.description: Swap kind; live SDK writes `given_in` and reserves `given_out`.

fields.name: limit
fields.description: Minimum output for `given_in`, or limit value for the step.

fields.name: next
fields.description: Optional next step for multi-hop swaps.

declarations.description: Per-step swap parameters embedded after the Pool address.

declarations.name: DedustSwapStep

fields.name: poolAddr
fields.description: Pool responsible for this swap step.

fields.name: params
fields.description: Step kind, limit, and optional next-hop reference.

declarations.description: Swap step routed by the Jetton Vault to a Pool.

declarations.name: DedustSwapParams

fields.name: deadline
fields.description: Unix timestamp deadline, or zero when disabled.

fields.name: recipientAddr
fields.description: Optional final recipient; `addr_none` means the default sender/owner path.

fields.name: referralAddr
fields.description: Optional referral address; `addr_none` disables referral routing.

fields.name: fulfillPayload
fields.description: Optional payload sent on successful fulfillment.

fields.name: rejectPayload
fields.description: Optional payload sent on rejection.

declarations.description: Whole-swap options stored in a required referenced cell.

declarations.name: Errors

members.name: InvalidJettonWalletSender
members.description: Jetton notification sender is not the stored vault wallet.

members.name: InvalidFactorySender
members.description: Factory message sender is not the stored Factory.

members.name: InvalidAssetOrPayload
members.description: Asset tag, forward payload, or proof shape is invalid for this Vault.

members.name: InsufficientValue
members.description: Attached value cannot cover the required downstream fee budget.

members.name: InvalidPoolSender
members.description: Pool payout sender is not the authenticated Pool.

members.name: InvalidLiquidityDepositSender
members.description: Liquidity-deposit payout sender is not the authenticated Liquidity Deposit.

members.name: VaultNotReady
members.description: Vault is not ready for code upgrade.

members.name: InvalidReadinessState
members.description: Vault readiness state does not match the requested operation.

members.name: InvalidDepositAmounts
members.description: Liquidity-deposit target amounts must be positive.

members.name: InvalidDepositAsset
members.description: Liquidity-deposit asset does not match the vault asset side.

members.name: InvalidOperatorSender
members.description: Reset-gas sender is not the deterministic Operator contract.

members.name: UnsupportedOperation
members.description: Incoming internal or forward-payload opcode is unsupported.

declarations.description: DeDust Jetton Vault v2 exit-code catalog.

get_methods.name: get_version
get_methods.description: Return the DeDust vault version stored as a 16-bit field.

get_methods.name: is_ready
get_methods.description: Return whether the Jetton wallet address has been synced and stored.

get_methods.name: get_factory_addr
get_methods.description: Return the authenticated Factory address stored in Jetton Vault state.

get_methods.name: get_wallet_addr
get_methods.description: Return the vault-owned Jetton wallet address, or `addr_none` before readiness sync.

get_methods.name: get_asset
get_methods.description: Return the Jetton asset slice; live USDT vault returns tag, workchain id, and minter hash.
